deficiencies.description: The rewrite resolves the lecturer's pointing words ('the tumor is here' and 'This is the outer surface of the uterus') by asserting that the tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus, which is not stated in the text.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You can see that the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus

deficiencies.description: The word 'therefore' adds an unsourced causal link, stating that the tumour is circumscribed as a result of the fixation, staining, hydration, and dehydration causing it to separate, whereas the lecturer merely stated that one can see that it is circumscribed.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: So you can see again that this is actually circumspect and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour is therefore circumscribed and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.

considerations.reason: The lecturer used 'circumspect' instead of 'circumscribed', which is a slip of the tongue. The rewrite's correction to 'circumscribed' is scientifically correct and thus permitted.

considerations.sourcePassage: so it might be difficult to necessarily find all of the possible secondary tumors
considerations.reason: The text states 'so it might be difficult', which directly justifies 'It might therefore be difficult' in the rewrite.
